title: Private Access authentication errors Client Connector users might see during enrollment: 2008 and the 42xxx codes the vendor lists

prose.label: What is not defined.
prose.text: The codes 42003, 42008, 42009, 42011, 42012 and 42041 are absent from the table {{gap:absent-codes}}. Where the user sees the code is not stated, and several codes share the message Internal Error: Contact Administrator {{gap:shared-message}}. How large a SAML assertion must be to trigger 42045 is not stated {{gap:assertion-size}}. What the client does with a stale assertion after enrollment is not settled by 42016 and 42021 {{gap:stale-assertion-later}}.

scope.statement: These are the error messages users might see from Client Connector during the Private Access enrollment process.

quotes: The table below provides a list of error messages your users might see for Zscaler Client Connector during the enrollment process.

2008-delayed-auth.statement: 2008 (invalid redirection URL) occurs when a user delays Private Access authentication; the action is to authenticate again, and contact Zscaler Support if it persists.

quotes: | 2008 | Authentication failed due to an invalid redirection URL. Please try again. | This error occurs when a user delays Private Access authentication. | Authenticate again. If the error persists, contact Zscaler Support. |

42000-identity-changed.statement: 42000 (Inconsistency in user credentials) occurs when the user attempts to reauthenticate to Private Access and either enters a different username from the one provided during initial enrollment, or the IdP SAML response has a different NameID from the one sent during initial enrollment. The vendor says to verify that the NameID is the one Private Access received at initial enrollment, or to have the user log out and re-enroll into Private Access.

quotes: | 42000 | Inconsistency in user credentials is detected. Log out of the client and retry. | When the user attempts to reauthenticate to Private Access, this error occurs if:
The user enters a different username instead of the one provided during initial enrollment.
The IdP SAML response has a different NameID instead of the one sent during initial enrollment.
verify that the IdP SAML response has the NameID that Private Access received during initial enrollment.
You can also have the user log out from Zscaler Client Connector and attempt to re-enroll into Private Access.

42001-no-domain.statement: 42001 occurs when a user attempts to log in to Client Connector without a domain name, so Private Access cannot identify the user's organization. The vendor says to verify the user entered a valid domain as part of the username (for example, joe@safemarch.com), unless the App installer was configured so that the domain name is not required, in which case the user would only enter joe.

quotes: | 42001 | Internal Error: Contact Administrator | This error occurs when a user attempts to log in to Zscaler Client Connector without a domain name.
In this case, Private Access cannot identify the user's organization and as a result cannot proceed further.
Verify that the user has entered a valid domain as part of the username (for example, joe@safemarch.com).
configured the App installer so that the domain name is not required in the username field (in this case, the user would only enter joe).

idp-setup.statement: 42002 occurs when Private Access is not configured correctly and cannot identify the IdP for enrolling the user; verify an IdP is configured for Private Access and can communicate with it. 42042: the IdP is disabled on Private Access; enable it at Administration > Identity > Private Access > IDP Configuration. 42043: the IdP is misconfigured (configuration incomplete). 42044: the SSO type and usage for the IdP configuration do not match.

quotes: | 42002 | ZscalerPrivate Access is not configured for your company. | This error occurs when Private Access is not configured correctly and is unable to identify the IdP that must be used for enrolling the user.
Verify that an IdP is configured for Private Access and that the IdP can communicate with Private Access.
| 42042 | Configured IdP is disabled for SSO. | This error occurs when IdP is disabled on Private Access. | Go to Administration > Identity > Private Access > IDP Configuration to enable the IdP. |
| 42043 | IdP configuration is incomplete. | This error occurs when the IdP is misconfigured.
| 42044 | IdP configuration has mismatched SSO type/usage. | This error occurs when the SSO type and usage for the IdP configuration do not match.

admin-vs-user-sso.statement: 42033 and 42034 occur when the Private Access service cannot validate the SAML response for the Private Access admin (42033) or user (42034); the action is to verify an IdP is configured for Private Access administrator SSO or user SSO respectively. 42037 occurs when the IdP is not enabled for admin SSO.

quotes: | 42033 | Private Access SP was not able to validate the SAML response. Please check the IdP configuration on both Private Access and your IdP. | This error occurs when the Private Access service cannot validate the SAML response for the Private Access admin.
Verify that an IdP is configured for Private Access administrator SSO

| 42034 | Private Access SP was not able to validate the SAML response. Please check the IdP configuration on both Private Access and your IDP. | This error occurs when the Private Access service cannot validate the SAML response for the Private Access user.
Verify that an IdP is configured for Private Access user SSO
| 42037 | IdP is not enabled for admin SSO.Please check the IdP for user admin SSO in your IDP configuration. | This error occurs when the IdP isn’t enabled for the admin SSO.

enrollment-exchange.statement: 42004 occurs when Client Connector does not send the expected information to Private Access during enrollment, and 42005 when Private Access cannot correctly interpret the information Client Connector sent; for both, verify SSO for Private Access is configured correctly. 42010 occurs when Private Access does not receive the expected information during enrollment; it is an internal error, so contact Zscaler Support. 42028 occurs when the Private Access authentication service receives a request with missing or unexpected information; contact Zscaler Support.

quotes: | 42004 | Internal Error: Contact Administrator | This error occurs if Zscaler Client Connector is not sending the expected information to Private Access during the user's enrollment process. | Verify that single sign-on (SSO) for Private Access has been configured correctly.

| 42005 | Internal Error: Contact Administrator | This error occurs if Private Access cannot correctly interpret the information sent by Zscaler Client Connector during the user's enrollment process. | Verify that SSO for Private Access has been configured correctly.

| 42010 | Internal Error: Contact Administrator | This error occurs if Private Access does not receive the expected information during the user enrollment process. | This is an internal error. Contact Zscaler Support. |

| 42028 | Unexpected or missing information when enrolling or unenrolling Zscaler Client Connector. | This error occurs if the Private Access authentication service receives a request from Zscaler Client Connector with missing or unexpected information. | Contact Zscaler Support. |

saml-response-validation.statement: 42006 occurs when SAML response validation fails, which could be due to the system clock being out of sync, an expired IdP certificate, a failure in the SAML response signature validation, or issues around IdP lookup by IdP entity ID. 42013: the IdP SAML response does not match the expected object type (update the IdP configuration). 42014: the status in the SAML response is unsuccessful (review the user's information in the IdP and have the user retry). 42015: failed to validate the SAML response signature, because the IdP certificates are not configured correctly or the public certificate Private Access uses to validate the response has expired (check the IdP certificate's expiration date and upload a valid one). 42022: the SAML response has no NameID (ensure NameID is part of the subject).

quotes: | 42006 | Internal Error: Contact Administrator | This error occurs when the SAML response validation fails. The failure could be due to issues like the system clock being out of sync, an expired IdP certificate, a failure in the SAML response signature validation, or issues around IdP lookup by IdP entity ID.

| 42013 | The message is not of the SAML response object type. | This error occurs if the IdP SAML response doesn’t match the expected SAML response object type. | Update the IdP configuration to send the expected object type in the SAML response. |

| 42014 | The SAML response status is unsuccessful. | This error occurs if the status in the SAML response is unsuccessful. | Review the user’s information in the IdP and have the user retry logging in. |
| 42015 | Failed to validate the SAML response signature. | This error occurs if: This error occurs if the IdP certificates aren't configured correctly
The public certificate used by Private Access to validate the SAML response from the IdP has expired.
Check the expiration date of the IdP certificate, and upload a valid certificate if the current certificate has expired.

| 42022 | Missing NameID in the SAML response. | This error occurs if the SAML response doesn't have NameID in it. | In the IdP configuration, ensure NameID is part of the subject in the SAML response message. |

clock-skew-and-conditions.statement: 42016 occurs when the response issue time is too old or in the future, because the IdP and the Private Access authentication service clocks have a large skew; the maximum accepted skew time is 120 seconds. 42021 occurs when assertion validation fails (the assertion is too old, or fails a notBefore or notOnOrAfter condition), which may be due to timing issues or unsupported assertion conditions such as OneTimeUse. 42032: the service does not support the OneTimeUse condition; update the IdP configuration to not issue a OneTimeUse SAML assertion.

quotes: This error occurs if the IdP and the Private Access authentication service clocks have a large skew. The maximum accepted skew time is 120 seconds.
| 42016 | The response issue time is either too old or with date in the future.

| 42021 | Possible error messages: The assertion is too old to be used. The assertion failed the validation because of the set notBefore condition. The assertion failed the validation because of the set notOnOrAfter condition.
The assertion validation may fail due to timing issues, unsupported assertion conditions (e.g., OneTimeUse condition), etc.

| 42032 | The Private Access authentication service doesn’t support the OneTimeUse condition in the SAML assertion. | This error occurs if the IdP issues a SAML assertion with the OneTimeUse condition. | Update the IdP configuration to not issue OneTimeUse SAML assertion. |

sp-initiated-only.statement: 42017 occurs when the IdP sends Private Access a SAML response without the Private Access authentication service initiating it; only service provider (SP) initiated SSO is supported with Private Access. 42018: the service failed to look up the SAML request corresponding to the response (contact Zscaler Support). 42019: the assertion consumer endpoint of the authentication service is not properly configured in the IdP (review the SP configuration in the IdP).

quotes: | 42017 | The IdP originated SSO is not supported. | This error occurs if the IdP sends Private Access a SAML response without the Private Access authentication service initiating it. | Only the service provider (SP) initiated SSO is supported with Private Access. |

| 42018 | Failed to look up the SAML request corresponding to the SAML response received. | This error occurs if the Private Access authentication service failed to look up the SAML request corresponding to the SAML response from its database. | Contact Zscaler Support. |

| 42019 | The intended destination doesn't match any of the configured endpoints. | This error occurs if the assertion consumer endpoint of the Private Access authentication service isn't properly configured in the IdP. | Review the SP configuration in your IdP. |

entity-id.statement: 42020 occurs when the IdP entity ID is not properly configured in the Admin Console, and the entity ID is case sensitive. 42036 occurs when the Private Access service cannot verify the entity ID for the IdP configuration. For both, review the entity ID of the IdP configuration in the Admin Console.

quotes: | 42020 | Failed to validate the issuer in the SAML response. | This error occurs if the IdP entity ID isn't properly configured in the Zscaler Admin Console. The entity ID is case sensitive. | In the Zscaler Admin Console, review the entity ID of the IdP configuration. |

| 42036 | Unable to verify the IdP configuration for the IdP entity ID. | This error occurs when the Private Access service cannot verify the entity ID for the IdP configuration. | In the Zscaler Admin Console, review the entity ID of the IdP configuration. |

enrollment-ca.statement: 42007 occurs when the certificate signing request in Private Access fails during enrollment; the vendor says to verify that the signing certificate chosen for enrolling devices is valid, notes that Private Access provides a default signing certificate, and says to check the Admin Console that it is still available. 42023, 42024 and 42025: the Client Connector CA (signing) certificate has expired, is missing, or its private key is missing; provision a valid CA certificate. 42026: Client Connector fails to get a valid certificate (contact Zscaler Support).

quotes: | 42007 | Internal Error: Contact Administrator | This error occurs when the certificate signing request in Private Access fails during the user enrollment process. | Verify that the signing certificate chosen for enrolling the user device to Private Access is valid.
Private Access provides a default signing certificate that can be used when enrolling user devices to Private Access.
Check the Zscaler Admin Console to ensure this certificate is still available, or if a new, valid certificate has been added in its place.

| 42023 | The CA certificate (signing certificate) for Zscaler Client Connector has expired. | This error occurs if the Central Authority (CA) certificate for Zscaler Client Connector has expired. | Provision a valid CA certificate for Zscaler Client Connector.

| 42024 | The CA certificate (signing certificate) for Zscaler Client Connector is missing. | This error occurs if the CA certificate for Zscaler Client Connector is missing. | Provision a valid CA certificate for Zscaler Client Connector. To learn more, see Understanding Preloaded Enrollment (CA) Certificates. |

| 42025 | The private key for the Zscaler Client Connector CA certificate (signing certificate) is missing. | This error occurs if the private key for the Zscaler Client Connector CA certificate is missing. | Provision a valid CA certificate for Zscaler Client Connector.
| 42026 | Unable to secure a valid certificate for this user. | This error occurs if Zscaler Client Connector fails to get a valid certificate. | Contact Zscaler Support. |

idp-and-sp-signing-certs.statement: 42046 occurs when the IdP's signing certificates in Private Access have expired; update the IdP configuration to upload a valid signing certificate from the IdP. 42047 and 42048 occur when the SAML request signing certificate configured in the Admin Console has expired (42047) or is not valid (42048); edit the IdP configuration to change the certificate used by the IdP to another certificate, and then update the IdP.

quotes: | 42046 | All the signing certificates associated with the IdP are expired. | This error occurs when a user tries to log in to Zscaler Client Connector and the IdP’s signing certificates in Private Access have expired. | Update the IdP configuration to upload a valid signing certificate from the IdP. |

| 42047 | The SAML request signing certificate has expired. | This error occurs if the SAML request signing certificate configured in Zscaler Admin Console has expired. | Edit the IdP configuration to change the certificate used by the IdP to another certificate, and then update the IdP.
| 42048 | The SAML request signing certificate is invalid. | This error occurs if the SAML request signing certificate configured in Zscaler Admin Console is not valid.
Edit the IdP configuration to change the certificate used by the IdP to another certificate, and then update the IdP.

user-limit-42027.statement: 42027 occurs when the organization has provisioned more users than the number allowed by its subscription; the vendor says to verify that the existing Private Access subscription meets the organization's needs.

quotes: | 42027 | Your organization has reached the limit for the maximum number of allowed users. | This error occurs if your organization has provisioned more users than the number allowed by its subscription. | Verify that the existing Private Access subscription meets the needs of your organization. |

domain-and-account.statement: 42029 occurs when the username has no domain associated with the organization; 42035 when the username's domain does not match any of the organization's domains; 42039 when the Private Access service cannot verify the service provider (SP) configuration for the domain. 42030 and 42031 occur due to missing information in the account associated with the Private Access service. For 42029, 42030, 42031 and 42035 the action is to contact Zscaler Support.

quotes: | 42029 | Unable to identify the user by domain from the provided username. | This error occurs if the user's username doesn't have a domain that is associated with the organization. | Contact Zscaler Support. |

| 42035 | User not authorized because of domain mismatch. Please check configuration on both Private Access and your IdP. | This error occurs if the user’s username domain doesn’t match any domains associated with the organization. | Contact Zscaler Support. |

| 42039 | Unable to verify the SP configuration for this domain. | This error occurs when the Private Access service cannot verify the service provider (SP) configuration for the domain. | Verify that the SP for IdP has been configured correctly.
| 42030 | Unable to look up the user’s organization information. | This error occurs due to missing information in the account associated with the Private Access service. | Contact Zscaler Support. |

| 42031 | Unable to authorize Zscaler Client Connector enrollment request. | This error occurs due to missing information in the account associated with the Private Access service. | Contact Zscaler Support. |

internal.statement: 42038 (Failed to insert into Object Store) and 42040 (Failed to encrypt) are internal errors; 42045 occurs when the IdP issues a SAML assertion that is larger than expected. For all three the action is to contact Zscaler Support.

quotes: | 42038 | Failed to insert into Object Store. | This is an internal error. | Contact Zscaler Support. |
| 42040 | Failed to encrypt. | This is an internal error. | Contact Zscaler Support. |
| 42045 | Zscaler Private Access: SAML Assertion input too large. | This error occurs if the IdP issues a SAML assertion that is larger than expected. | Contact Zscaler Support. |

absent-codes.title: What codes 42003, 42008, 42009, 42011, 42012 and 42041 mean
absent-codes.detail: The vendor table does not list these codes, and nothing may be inferred for them from the neighbouring codes.

shared-message.title: Where the user sees the error code, and how to tell the codes that share one message apart
shared-message.detail: 42001, 42004, 42005, 42006, 42007 and 42010 share the message Internal Error: Contact Administrator, so only the code tells them apart. The page does not say where the user sees the code, in the app window or in logs.

assertion-size.title: How large a SAML assertion triggers 42045
assertion-size.detail: The table says only that the assertion is larger than expected and gives no size. A size limit documented for ZIA SAML responses is for another service and is not transferred.

stale-assertion-later.title: What Client Connector does with a stale SAML assertion after enrollment
stale-assertion-later.detail: 42016 and 42021 cover assertion timing at enrollment. They do not say what the client does with a stale assertion later, so the related open question in the Private Access authentication troubleshooting subject is not settled by this page.
